title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
abstract: arXiv:2611.24681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the $(k+q)$-th power of its size, where $k$ is the dimension of the integration domain and $q$ is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agent

translated_title: DrawScore：基于工程图纸评估生成的CAD模型
translated_abstract: 自动CAD生成通常采用体积IoU、Chamfer距离和表面F分数进行评估，这些指标几乎无法惩罚仅占零件体积或表面积很小比例的局部错误，例如孔的位置放错或槽开在了错误的面上，尽管此类错误对制造而言至关重要。我们将这些指标形式化为统一的积分形式，并证明局部错误的权重随其尺寸的(k+q)次幂衰减，其中k为积分域的维度，q由惩罚函数决定。受此分析启发，我们提出DrawScore，它像工程图纸一样将两个模型投影为带有可见线和隐藏线的三视图，并沿投影曲线施加饱和惩罚，使局部错误的权重仅线性衰减。受控实验证实了预测的衰减阶数，并在现有CAD生成代理的输出上……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出DrawScore新评估指标，通过工程图纸式三视图投影与饱和惩罚，使孔位错误等制造关键的小体积局部缺陷权重仅线性衰减，从而有效弥补传统体积类指标对局部错误不敏感的问题。
en_tdlr: DrawScore is a new metric that projects CAD models into engineering-drawing-style orthographic views and applies a saturating penalty, so that small but manufacturing-critical local errors (e.g., misplaced holes) decay only linearly in weight, addressing the insensitivity of conventional volumetric metrics to local defects.
